# Parley v0.1.67

This unnotarized test beta brings the embedded Ghostty terminal up to its
newest wrapper release and fixes a Git read failure that could hit any Mac
with a full Xcode selected. Nothing changes in saved data or the agent
protocol.

## Ghostty wrapper from our own fork

- The embedded Ghostty moves from upstream commit `0538f753` (29 September)
  to `35a81a98` (5 October) through libghostty-spm 2.2.2026101003, taking
  the wrapper's recent fixes with it: a surface keeps its font size across
  config reloads, the background colour follows the controller in dark
  mode, copied text no longer carries the padding a TUI paints around it,
  and a selection that scrolled the view puts the viewport back when it
  goes.
- That wrapper release needs Xcode's `xcstringstool` to build, which the
  Command Line Tools do not ship. Parley therefore takes it from
  `github.com/markjoyeuxcom/libghostty-spm`, whose weekly workflow
  republishes each upstream tag as `<tag>-clt` with the string catalog
  compiled ahead of time. Building Parley still needs only the Command
  Line Tools. The upstream request is Lakr233/libghostty-spm#81.

## Fixes

- **Git reads with a full Xcode selected.** `/usr/bin/git` is Apple's
  shim; with Xcode selected and a cold xcrun cache it starts `xcodebuild`
  before Git runs, which Parley's guarded reads refuse. The worktree board,
  delegation Git facts, context Git Diff and cleanup previews could all
  report failures after a boot. Parley now resolves the real Git behind the
  shim itself, from the selected developer directory or the Command Line
  Tools, and runs that under the guard. CI runs on a full Xcode to keep it
  that way.

## For agents

- The engineering guide starts a session from the Prax project card
  (`prax overview --project parley`) and asks agents to report the notes
  that informed their work.

## Going back to v0.1.66

Nothing in this release changes saved reviews, workspaces or the agent
protocol (still 34). v0.1.66 reads everything this version writes.

## Validation and known limits

The release workflow repeats the following before publishing this beta:
- the deterministic checks and the repository scans;
- the app build and the 25-round Ghostty soak;
- packaging, checksums and packaged-launch verification.

Checked before the pull requests merged: 598 native checks, 82 script
tests, both scans, the build and the 25-round soak in a Command Line Tools
Tart VM, and the checks on GitHub's Xcode 26.6 runner. Not yet checked by
hand in the app: the updated Ghostty renderer across sleep and wake, and
the v0.1.65 items still waiting for a hand test.

Agy's loading of Parley's instructions from its added folder is still
unverified, fresh or resumed.

This is an ad-hoc-signed, unnotarized test beta. It does not update the
stable Sparkle feed or Homebrew cask. Follow the included installation
instructions.
